messages:
Sam: Quick sync  planning a stepped regional rebalance: shift small batches from na-edge -> eu-edge tomorrow to validate perf and caches. Target: 15% total (3 increments of 5%). Window (UTC): stepA 2026-03-18T02:00Z, stepB 2026-03-18T02:30Z, stepC 2026-03-18T03:00Z. At T-15m we'll set DNS TTL=60s and revert to 300s after the window. Policy id: `stepped-epsilon-v2` (route-tier=regional, fallback=na-legacy). Need: deploy owner, smoke runner(s), and rollback pair. Reply w/ ownership and quick prechecks. :rocket:

Alex: I can run the policy apply and TTL flip. I'll announce start/completion here. @Maya will you take the CR review for the policy PR? https://git.redwood/infra/route-policies/pulls/321

Maya: On it, starting review now. Quick Q: do we want passive health probe thresholds adjusted for eu during the shift? If so, propose raising probe timeout from 2s->3s for 20m.

Sam: Good call. Let's bump timeout to 3s for the window. Add as a single-line change in the PR.

Noah: Rollback playbook request: prefer an automated weight-swap, but need exact CLI steps so oncall can revert in <2min. Also confirm who will call the rollback.

Sam: Rollback short play: 1) run `infra/routectl set-policy --policy steady-default --region global` 2) set DNS TTL=300 3) if sessions persist, `tools/drain-edge --region eu --grace 60s` 4) enable circuit-breaker `infra/cb set --region eu --enable`. Pager to #eng-sre and tag CHG-4521. Rollback leader: @Noah unless otherwise called.

Rio: Note: expect cache-warm problems on eu; doing pre-warm recommended. Use `./tools/edge-warmup.sh --region eu --targets top100` ~5m before stepA. Also watch CDN invalidation TTLs.

Maya: I'll run warmup and the smoke suite. My smoke checklist below; I'll paste results after each step.

Infra-bot: Scheduled DNS TTL change: 2026-03-18T01:45:00Z -> set TTL=60s. Will post execution result.

Devex Bot: Change ticket CHG-4521 created by Sam: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CHG-4521 :page_with_curl:

Alex: My rollout checklist (run sequentially per step):
1) apply policy: `infra/routectl apply --policy stepped-epsilon-v2 --increment 5`
2) run quick smoke: `./deploy/smoke.sh --quick`
3) check traces: Jaeger tag `deploy/1779998888`
4) Grafana panels: Edge > eu > p95 latency and 5xx rate
5) post short status here: e.g., "stepA done - 5% - OK"

Maya: Smoke checklist to post (I will paste outputs):
- `curl -fsS https://api.redwood/health -o /dev/null || echo FAIL` -> expect silent
- `tools/loadgen --profile hello-quick --duration 45s` -> watch latency distro
- `kubectl -n eu logs -l app=edge-proxy --tail 150 | grep -i error` -> expect none
- check SLOs: p95 < 220ms, error rate < 0.5%

Noah: Also confirm circuit-breaker threshold: 5% errors. If errors > 2% after any step, we consider revert. If >5% trigger immediate rollback. I'll act as rollback lead unless I hand-off.

Sam: I'll be on pager and monitoring. Escalation: tag @Noah and @Rio. Keep messages short after each step (done/ok/rollback). Quiet otherwise. :eyes:

Alex: Copy. I'll post time-stamped start/finish and the %s moved. I'll also attach short perf snapshots.

Maya: I'll paste results after stepA and stepB. Planning to run warmup at T-5m and start smoke ~T+3m after each step to let caches settle.

Rio: If you need cache footprint numbers, run `infra/metrics --topic cache-hit-rates --region eu --since 30m` before stepA.

Sam: Final ask: anyone with objections or required prechecks drop them now. Otherwise we'll proceed with the plan and update CHG-4521 with the post-window notes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
